verdict.rationale: AngelList's stakeholder experience gives holders their own dashboard showing all holdings (convertible notes, shares, transfers) across companies, lets them e-sign acceptance of issued securities, and lets founders preview each stakeholder's dashboard, so the self-serve holdings view is documented. However, nothing documents structured investor updates or reporting pushed to stakeholders. The update FAQ also points customers to J.P. Morgan and Pulley as alternative cap-table providers, which raises doubt about the equity product's continuity. Missing for 10: a documented structured investor-update/reporting channel, investor-specific portal detail beyond the generic stakeholder dashboard, clarity on the equity product's ongoing availability, and independent hands-on corroboration.
